name: dbmanager-frontend
description: dbmanager Vue3 前端(精简版迁移), 产物纯静态 dist/, 由后端 python http.server serve

scripts.i18n:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const k=f=>new Set([...fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').matchAll(/^\s*'([^']+)':/gm)].map(m=>m[1]));const zh=k('src/i18n/locales/zh-CN.ts');const en=k('src/i18n/locales/en.ts');const miss=[...zh.difference(en)];const extra=[...en.difference(zh)];if(miss.length||extra.length){console.error('i18n key mismatch\n only in zh:',miss,'\n only in en:',extra);process.exit(1)}console.log('i18n keys symmetric: '+zh.size+' entries ✓')"
